topic.title: Communicating with Authors
topic.shortdesc: Review tasks support discussions between authors and reviewers so that feedback can be clarified and resolved in context.

body.p: Review tasks are not only for marking issues. They also provide a place for discussion. Reviewers can reply to comments, answer questions, and clarify the intent behind their feedback.

section.title: Why communication matters
section.p: Some feedback is easy to apply, but some issues need discussion. A short exchange between the reviewer and the author can prevent misunderstandings and help the team agree on the best change.

ul.li: Keep replies focused on the content issue.
Explain the reason for your feedback.
Use the discussion thread to keep related feedback together.

section.title: Goal of the discussion
section.p: The goal is to help the author improve the content. Clear and respectful communication makes the review process faster and more useful for everyone involved.
